name: NE Alberta 12-Unit
description: This 12-unit apartment building sits in the heart of the Alberta Arts District, one of NE Portland's most walkable and character-rich neighborhoods. Built in 1962, the building has been thoughtfully maintained by long-term ownership with meaningful capital improvements over the past decade.

The block itself has become one of Portland's most desirable rental corridors — anchored by Alberta Street's restaurants, coffee shops, and small businesses. Renter demand has been consistently strong, with the current owner reporting sub-30-day vacancy turnarounds.

For the right buyer, this is a rare opportunity to own a well-located inner-Portland asset with reliable in-place income and clear paths to further rent growth. Well-suited for a 1031 exchange buyer seeking a long-term hold.
